scope: SCOPED from 404,000 characters to the public-facing core, one module. ss 4A and 4B (deposit-taking prohibition and what a deposit is), s 5 (the word bank), s 47 with Third Schedule Part 1 (banking secrecy), s 57(1) to (3) (credit card applications and advertising), ss 61 and 62 (priority in a bank's winding up). Not encoded: Parts 2 to 7 otherwise (licensing procedure, capital, shareholdings, mergers, prohibited business, minimum assets, control powers), Part 7A, Part 7B (merchant banks), Part 8 beyond s 57, Part 9 otherwise, and the regulations and notices.
